message.subject: Order support request — EXAMPLE-001
message.body:
Hello,
My refund is pending.
Order ID: EXAMPLE-001
Placed on: 2026-10-20
Amount: ₹2696.77
Payment method: upi
Items: Dolo / 650 / qty 15
Refund requested on: 2026-10-22
Support contacted on: 2026-10-28
Please confirm the refund status and reference.
Please confirm the amount due for refund.
Please refund to my original payment method.
Thank you.

ladder.how: Use the seller's email or order app chat

ladder.why: Secondary sources describe acknowledgement within 48 hours and redress within 1 month; check on the official site
If there is no reply by the acknowledgement check, ask the helpline about next options; check on the official site

followUps.text: Check acknowledgement; check on the official site
Check resolution status; check on the official site

notes: Message is a draft for you to review and send.

SECONDARY SOURCES ONLY (news and law-firm notes). Every item must be checked on the official page and re-dated before the app shows it to a patient. Until then the app must label it 'check on the official site'.
Refund completion time is not verified; no number is promised.
ASSUMPTION: wait 2 days after contacting support before escalation; this is not a verified rule.
ASSUMPTION: resolution reminder uses +30 days as specified; it is not a calendar-month calculation or a verified deadline.
Follow-ups are planned dates. Recompute with events.grievanceSentOn after you actually send the complaint.
output.disclaimer: Review and send this message yourself. Parchi does not send messages, handle money or provide legal advice.
